description: This file defines the 'Renewal' React component, a frontend page for renewing a tourist's validity period via a form that interacts with an API. It includes user interface elements such as input fields and buttons, handles state, and makes API calls.

methods.name: Renewal()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the renewal form, managing user input, and handling the renewal process.

methods.name: onRenew
methods.description: Asynchronous function invoked when the user clicks the 'Renew' button. It performs validation, makes an API call to renew the tourist's validity, and handles success or error responses.
